character: Largest Vosges ski area, forest skiing, 58 km
name: La Bresse Hohneck
description: 58km of pistes (21km skiable, 30 runs), 18 lifts, on the Hohneck summit (1,363m). The largest ski resort in the Vosges mountains. Known for: night skiing (Tue/Fri 5-9pm, €15), excellent bike park (summer), the Hohneck summit views (Alps on clear days), blueberry picking in summer, and 70% snowmaking. Family-focused Vosges culture — tartiflette, tofailles, and local beer at La Corne du Diable.

suitability.families: Good — night skiing, bike park in summer
